title: LaBella Associates hires Christian Hill, bringing stormwater and erosion control expertise to its Central New York operations
summary: LaBella Associates DPC, a civil engineering firm operating in Central New York, has hired Christian Hill as a senior civil engineer to expand stormwater management, site design, and erosion control capabilities. This private sector hiring signals continued infrastructure and environmental engineering activity in the region relevant to municipal stormwater and water management initiatives.
